trust_decision.summary: A social/OAuth login may only resolve (sign up, link into, or open a session on) a local account using an email address the identity provider itself attested; the decision is made once in OAuthCallbackHandler after provider processing and before the signup/link branches, and the attested flag is produced per-provider.

landing_point.why: The summary's 'OAuth identity linking to unverified email accounts' points straight at the email-keyed lookup that decides signup vs login; the account merge/stolen-session branch sits immediately below at 269-320.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The obvious fix is the shared ID-token mapper: everything that decodes a typed token funnels through oidcClaims (oauth_callback.go:471-506), so adding email_verified there 'covers the OIDC providers', while the processors that unmarshal raw JSON maps are treated as a different concern whose addresses are already verified by construction (GitHub filters to Verified, Discord/Twitter/Roblox synthesize non-routable addresses) - which leaves Apple, LinkedIn, Discord and Roblox with no attestation signal at all.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A returning federated user whose stored account is unverified because the same provider never attested the address: the pre-hijack guard deletes and recreates the account on every login, silently dropping its id, roles and org memberships; the legitimate behaviour is that this account must keep working, so the delete has to be scoped to accounts created by another credential and additionally bounded to stateless accounts. A second, cross-file legitimate behaviour is the per-org OIDC broker, which must keep accepting IdPs that omit email_verified for brand-new principals - an over-broad 'refuse any unattested federated email' fix breaks org SSO, and SAML asserts the address by construction.

O6_input_shapes: email_verified as a JSON boolean (Google, Twitch, Microsoft, Roblox)
email_verified as the quoted string "true" (Apple documents both forms; LinkedIn ships both) - handled by flexBool/claimTruthy
email_verified absent altogether (Entra v2 ID tokens carry none) - must decode to unverified, not to a decode error
Microsoft xms_edov optional claim standing in for email_verified
Microsoft tid vs iss consistency plus multi-tenant aliases common/organizations/consumers versus a pinned GUID/domain, and a --microsoft-allowed-tenants list
map-decoded provider payloads: Discord `verified`, Roblox `email_verified`, LinkedIn userinfo `email_verified`
synthetic fallback addresses (discord-<id>/twitter-<id>/roblox-<sub> on .oauth.internal) that are attested by construction
GitHub REST /user email versus the /user/emails fallback filtered to Verified addresses
signup_methods as a comma-separated list containing the near-miss pair twitch/twitter, needing an exact-token match not a substring match
--oauth-allow-unverified-provider-email compatibility flag: found vs not-found, and same-provider vs other-credential ownership

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An eleventh social provider added to the callback switch whose processor returns only (*schemas.User, error) again
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: All ten existing processors had exactly that signature at the pinned commit, so copying the neighbouring case is the natural way to add a provider - and the new one then has no way to surface attestation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The org OIDC SSO broker resolving an existing local account by the upstream email instead of refusing the collision
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The broker already builds the same federatedProfile shape and already sits next to a one-line collision guard at oauth_sso.go:574-578, so a per-org 'link my enterprise users to their existing accounts' setting is a plausible feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: extractSAMLProfile continuing to hardcode EmailVerified: true while a sibling IdP-broker path starts linking by email
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The SAML and OIDC brokers share jitProvisionFederatedUser by design; a maintainer extending the shared core to link by email would inherit the hardcoded true and reintroduce the same trust-the-IdP-attribute flaw.

O9_family: improper authentication / federated account linking and takeover (CWE-287, nOAuth class)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add email_verified to the shared oidcClaims mapper and hard-refuse any unattested provider email right before the account lookup, leaving the seven raw-map processors open and deleting or locking out legitimate same-provider returning users.
